question: For each match, considering every innings, please combine runs from both batsman scored and extra runs for each over, then identify the single over with the highest total runs, retrieve the bowler for that over from the ball by ball table, and calculate the average of these highest over totals across all matches, ensuring that all runs and bowler details are accurately reflected.
sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.match_id,
        bs.over_id,
        bs.innings_no,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as batsman_runs,
        COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as extra_runs_total,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0), 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bs.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = er.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bs.over_id, bs.innings_no
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_runs) as max_over_total
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over_details AS (
    SELECT 
        om.match_id,
        om.max_over_total,
        orv.over_id,
        orv.innings_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY om.match_id ORDER BY orv.over_id) as rn
    FROM max_over_per_match om
    JOIN over_runs orv ON om.match_id = orv.match_id 
        AND orv.total_runs = om.max_over_total
),
single_max_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, max_over_total, over_id, innings_no
    FROM max_over_details
    WHERE rn = 1
),
bowler_info AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.match_id,
        sm.max_over_total,
        sm.over_id,
        sm.innings_no,
        bb.bowler
    FROM single_max_over sm
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON sm.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND sm.over_id = bb.over_id
        AND bb.ball_id = 1
)
SELECT AVG(max_over_total) as average_highest_over_total FROM bowler_info
